svg.text: Fine-Grained Subscription System: Reactive State Architecture

g.text: Coarse vs Fine-Grained
Coarse-Grained (Redux default)
useSelector(state => state.user)
→ Re-renders whenever ANY field of user changes
→ Avatar re-renders even when only email changed
→ Must use reselect to narrow — opt-in memoization
Problem: large stores cause unnecessary renders at scale
Fine-Grained (Jotai / MobX / Signals)
const [name] = useAtom(userNameAtom)
→ Re-renders ONLY when name changes
→ Avatar atom: independent, tracks only avatar
→ Dependency tracking is automatic
→ Derived atoms recalc only their deps changed
Atoms are the leaves of reactivity — minimal rerender surface
Subscription Mechanics
Observable / Signal Pattern
Store: map of {key: {value, subscribers: Set}}
Subscribe: add handler to Set for specific key
Set value: update value, notify all subscribers
Unsubscribe: remove handler from Set
Batch: defer notifications until transaction ends
prevents intermediate re-renders during multi-write
Equality check: skip notify if value === prev (Object.is)
React: useSyncExternalStore for safe subscription + tearing prevention
Dependency Tracking (Automatic)
During computation: push current observer onto tracking stack
When signal/atom read: register observer as subscriber
Pop observer off stack when computation ends
Result: reading a signal auto-subscribes the reader
Dynamic deps: re-track after each evaluation (conditional reads)
Glitch-free: topological sort ensures consistent update order
Used by: Preact Signals, SolidJS, Vue Computed, MobX computed
Zustand: Selective Subscriptions
const name = useStore(state => state.user.name) ← subscribes to name only
useStore(state => state.user, shallow) ← shallow equality on object
Selector = subscription scope. Always use narrow selectors for performance.

svg.text: 100k row list: fine-grained subscriptions critical — coarse = unusable.
